title: Understanding OCD and complex trauma with Alexandra Walker

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, we are taking a close look at complex trauma and obsessive-compulsive disorder.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将深入探讨复杂性创伤和强迫症。

sentences.en: We are chatting with Alexandra, who is somebody who has experienced these things from her childhood.
sentences.zh: 我们将与 Alexandra 聊天，她是一位从小就经历过这些事情的人。

sentences.en: And we piece together what has contributed to what she's experienced in adulthood.
sentences.zh: 我们将一起梳理出是什么导致了她成年后的经历。

sentences.en: I think this is a really interesting topic.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常有趣的话题。

sentences.en: I hope it's one that you will relate to.
sentences.zh: 希望你能从中产生共鸣。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I am a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: For those of you who have been in my world for a little while, you might already know that working with people with complex trauma and grief is one of my clinical specialties.
sentences.zh: 对于那些关注我一段时间的人来说，你们可能已经知道，与复杂性创伤和悲伤患者一起工作是我的临床专长之一。

sentences.en: This is something that I started in my career in the NHS and have continued into my private practice.
sentences.zh: 这是我在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）职业生涯中开始，并延续到私人诊所的工作。

sentences.en: But what is complex trauma?
sentences.zh: 但什么是复杂性创伤呢？

sentences.en: What are the symptoms that will commonly crop up?
sentences.zh: 通常会出现哪些症状？

sentences.en: What might contribute to it?
sentences.zh: 什么因素可能导致它？

sentences.en: And how can OCD make sense as a way of coping and surviving?
sentences.zh: 强迫症作为一种应对和生存方式，又是如何说得通的呢？

sentences.en: This is what we are talking about in today's episode, as I speak with a real person who has experienced these difficulties.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天节目要讨论的内容，我将与一位真正经历过这些困难的人交谈。

sentences.en: I hope you find it really useful, really interesting.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它非常有用，非常有趣。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我期待在节目结束后与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾。

sentences.en: Alexandra, hi.
sentences.zh: Alexandra，你好。

sentences.en: Hi, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 嗨，谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Hi there, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 你好，Marianne。

sentences.en: It's lovely to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So we wanted to have a chat today about your experiences growing up and how that's kind of shaped you and what you've reclaimed from that, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天想聊聊你成长过程中的经历，以及这些经历是如何塑造你的，还有你从中找回了什么。

sentences.en: And I know that your book is called Reclaiming Christmas, so I'm sure we'll hear a little bit more about that.
sentences.zh: 我知道你的书叫《找回圣诞节》（Reclaiming Christmas），所以我相信我们会听到更多关于它的内容。

sentences.en: For anyone that's like, we're going to Christmas, where are we?
sentences.zh: 对于那些可能会想“我们要聊圣诞节了，这是在哪儿？”的人，

sentences.en: Like, we're recording this in May, but this is just a book title.
sentences.zh: 我们是在五月份录制的，但这只是书名。

sentences.en: It's not a seasonal book, is it?
sentences.zh: 这不是一本季节性书籍，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a book for anyone that's interested in learning more about trauma.
sentences.zh: 这是一本写给任何有兴趣了解更多关于创伤的人的书。

sentences.en: So just before we get going, tell us a little bit about yourself, Alexandra.
sentences.zh: 那么在开始之前，Alexandra，请简单介绍一下你自己。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: So I started off life in academia.
sentences.zh: 我最初是在学术界开始生活的。

sentences.en: I did a postdoctorate in applied maths.
sentences.zh: 我做了应用数学的博士后。

sentences.en: And I met my husband, who did a postdoctorate in physics.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了我的丈夫，他做了物理学博士后。

sentences.en: That tended to end quite a lot of conversations when we told people that, because it's a slightly scary combination.
sentences.zh: 当我们告诉别人这一点时，谈话往往就此终结，因为这是一个有点吓人的组合。

sentences.en: But then we moved to London and pursued corporate careers.
sentences.zh: 但后来我们搬到了伦敦，追求企业职业生涯。

sentences.en: So I was in the civil service for 12 years and then moved into the charitable sector.
sentences.zh: 我在公务员系统工作了 12 年，然后转入了慈善部门。

sentences.en: But I just wasn't happy and I wasn't well, basically, for that entire time.
sentences.zh: 但基本上在那整段时间里，我并不快乐，身体也不好。

sentences.en: And so I've been through quite a long journey of getting better and understanding why I had a bit of a myriad of mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 所以我经历了一段很长的康复之旅，去理解为什么我有各种各样的心理健康问题。

sentences.en: And I've now recently set up my new business, Damsel Not in Distress, to support people to recover after life challenges.
sentences.zh: 我最近创办了我的新企业“Damsel Not in Distress”，旨在支持人们在经历人生挑战后恢复。

sentences.en: And I now live in what is today the very sunny North West Highlands of Scotland.
sentences.zh: 我现在住在苏格兰西北高地，那里今天阳光明媚。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: What a journey.
sentences.zh: 多么奇妙的旅程。

sentences.en: What a journey.
sentences.zh: 多么奇妙的旅程。

sentences.en: And I can see why that might have stopped dinner party conversations, because of how daunted people must be by the incredible genius of you and your husband combined.
sentences.zh: 我明白为什么这可能会让晚宴谈话中断了，因为人们一定会被你和你丈夫结合在一起的惊人天赋所震慑。

sentences.en: But North West Scotland sounds beautiful.
sentences.zh: 但苏格兰西北部听起来很美。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, it turned out hill walking has been a massive part of my recovery.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实证明，爬山是我康复过程中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And I slightly unnerved my husband when we were living in London.
sentences.zh: 当我们住在伦敦时，我稍微让我丈夫感到不安。

sentences.en: And it was just after my mother had died about 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那大约是在 10 年前我母亲去世后不久。

sentences.en: And I said, I think we should try to climb all the Monroes, which are the hills above 3000 feet.
sentences.zh: 我说，我想我们应该尝试爬完所有的 Munro 山峰，也就是海拔 3000 英尺以上的山丘。

sentences.en: The only thing there being there are 282 of them.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，一共有 282 座。

sentences.en: And it's quite a feat to try and climb them all from London, because obviously you have a very long journey to even get to the foot of the hill before you can start.
sentences.zh: 从伦敦出发去爬完它们是一项艰巨的任务，因为显然在开始爬山之前，你得先经过很长的路程才能到达山脚。

sentences.en: But we did it all in about seven years and finished just during the pandemic, actually.
sentences.zh: 但我们在大约七年内完成了所有这些，实际上是在疫情期间结束的。

sentences.en: And walking is just a wonderful, restorative thing for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，步行是一件美妙而有修复作用的事情。

sentences.en: So we're now here permanently, which is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在永久住在这里，非常美丽。

sentences.en: Oh, amazing.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: That sounds like a PR worthy pitch in itself, wanting to climb all of the Monroes.
sentences.zh: 想要爬完所有 Munro 山峰，这听起来本身就是一个值得公关的卖点。

sentences.en: Yes, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实是。

sentences.en: At the beginning, I had no idea what I was getting myself into, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，刚开始的时候，我根本不知道自己卷入了什么。

sentences.en: But I got incredibly much fitter than I was before and, you know, scrambled up rock faces and did things I'd never imagined I would do.
sentences.zh: 但我变得比以前健康多了，你知道，我攀爬岩壁，做了我从未想象过自己会做的事情。

sentences.en: I abseiled, which I seriously never imagined I would do.
sentences.zh: 我尝试了绳降，这我真的从未想过自己会做。

sentences.en: So, yes, it's certainly got me to try out new things and get comfortable with new things.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它确实让我尝试了新事物，并适应了新事物。

sentences.en: Well, I'm really pleased to hear that you found a wonderful coping strategy.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听到你找到了一个很棒的应对策略。

sentences.en: But of course, what would be useful to know is a little bit about what you were trying to cope with and why.
sentences.zh: 但当然，了解你试图应对的是什么以及原因会很有用。

sentences.en: And I'm aware this is not a therapy session, and so I always want you to feel protected and safe in what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不是心理治疗，所以我总是希望你在我们谈论的内容中感到被保护和安全。

sentences.en: But in terms of our listeners, you know, they are often psychology students or psychology graduates pursuing professional psychology qualifications.
sentences.zh: 但就我们的听众而言，你知道，他们通常是心理学学生或正在追求专业心理学资格的心理学毕业生。

sentences.en: And so it would be a really nice opportunity for myself and for our listeners and watchers to kind of get a little bit of an understanding about what complex trauma is,
sentences.zh: 所以，这对我、我们的听众和观众来说，是一个很好的机会，可以稍微了解一下什么是复杂性创伤，

sentences.en: what kind of things might create it.
sentences.zh: 以及什么样的经历可能会导致它。

sentences.en: Would that be OK, Alexandra?
sentences.zh: 这样可以吗，Alexandra？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And that is part of my mission in life now.
sentences.zh: 这也是我现在人生使命的一部分。

sentences.en: So I'm very comfortable to share about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常乐意分享这些。

sentences.en: So the crux of my issues, I now understand, has unfortunately been that I suffered emotional abuse from my father.
sentences.zh: 我理解，我问题的症结不幸在于我遭受了父亲的情感虐待。

sentences.en: And that, I believe, started before I was aware, because my first memory of him is being wary of him when I, you know, when I was about four.
sentences.zh: 我相信这在我意识到之前就开始了，因为我对他的第一记忆是当我大约四岁时，对他感到警惕。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: But I did not realise what the issue was, because it's a bit like, you know, just being that frog in ever increasing hot water.
sentences.zh: 但我没有意识到问题所在，因为这有点像，你知道，就像那只在不断加热的水里的青蛙。

sentences.en: You just don't know what you don't know.
sentences.zh: 你只是不知道你所不知道的。

sentences.en: And you certainly don't know what normal looks like or what good looks like.
sentences.zh: 而且你肯定不知道什么是正常的，或者什么是好的。

sentences.en: You just know what your environment is.
sentences.zh: 你只知道你的环境是什么样的。

sentences.en: And there's no doubt that my father loved me.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，我父亲是爱我的。

sentences.en: But he was a very complicated character.
sentences.zh: 但他是一个非常复杂的人物。

sentences.en: And the best analogy I've come up with is that he was like Jekyll and Hyde, the Robert Louis Stevenson novel,
sentences.zh: 我想出的最好的类比是，他就像罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森小说里的杰基尔和海德，

sentences.en: where he could be really loving and caring one minute and then suddenly become really angry and difficult the next.
sentences.zh: 他可能前一分钟还非常慈爱和关心，下一分钟突然变得非常愤怒和难以相处。

sentences.en: And for a young child, I think not knowing what version of your caregiver is going to pitch up is really, really unnerving.
sentences.zh: 对于一个年幼的孩子来说，我认为不知道你的照顾者会表现出哪一面，真的非常非常令人不安。

sentences.en: But so that's that that is the crux of the story.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是故事的症结所在。

sentences.en: But if you roll back 20 years, I didn't know any of this.
sentences.zh: 但如果你回溯 20 年，我对此一无所知。

sentences.en: I was a young adult.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个年轻人。

sentences.en: I already had a few mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 我已经有一些心理健康问题了。

sentences.en: So I had a spider phobia from pretty much as long as I can remember, which was very bad.
sentences.zh: 我对蜘蛛有恐惧症，几乎从我记事起就有，而且非常严重。

sentences.en: Even talking about them was difficult, let alone seeing one, which was way more traumatic.
sentences.zh: 甚至谈论它们都很困难，更不用说看到一只了，那更具创伤性。

sentences.en: And then there were the early signs of OCD, which turned up when I was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 然后是强迫症的早期迹象，出现在我十几岁的时候。

sentences.en: Then and it's interesting how these events kind of layer onto each other.
sentences.zh: 然后，这些事件像层叠一样叠加在一起，这很有趣。

sentences.en: The next thing that happened was that I unfortunately contracted pneumonia when I was 15
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事情是，我在 15 岁时不幸患上了肺炎，

sentences.en: and I had to have very strong antibiotics to deal with the pneumonia, which absolutely categorically saved my life.
sentences.zh: 我不得不使用非常强效的抗生素来治疗肺炎，这绝对挽救了我的生命。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, what they also did was basically strip my digestive system of all the good bacteria.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它们也基本上清除了我消化系统中的所有益生菌。

sentences.en: And again, I know that now I didn't know at the time what was going on.
sentences.zh: 同样，我现在知道了，当时我并不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: All I knew was that I got discharged from hospital with pneumonia a few days.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我因肺炎出院几天了。

sentences.en: I think it was Christmas Eve, actually.
sentences.zh: 我想实际上是平安夜。

sentences.en: And then a couple of days later, I was in agony.
sentences.zh: 然后几天后，我痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: I couldn't eat anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都吃不下。

sentences.en: I literally could not eat anything.
sentences.zh: 我真的什么都吃不下。

sentences.en: And nobody knew what was wrong with me.
sentences.zh: 没人知道我出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And to cut a long story short, I was in hospital for a number of weeks.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，我在医院住了好几个星期。

sentences.en: And it was an incredibly distressing experience and in particular distressing because, unfortunately, it was a very busy time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段极其痛苦的经历，特别痛苦的原因是，不幸的是，那是一个非常繁忙的时期。

sentences.en: And I don't remember anyone really being kind to me.
sentences.zh: 我不记得有人真正对我友善过。

sentences.en: So I was on my own a lot of the time in a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 所以我大部分时间都是一个人，承受着巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: And secondly, nobody knew what was wrong with me.
sentences.zh: 其次，没人知道我出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And I got some kind of misdiagnosis stuff coming in, which was really difficult to deal with as well.
sentences.zh: 我得到了一些错误的诊断，这也很难处理。

sentences.en: So basically, in a nutshell, I developed post-traumatic stress disorder from that and it really intensified my OCD.
sentences.zh: 所以简而言之，我因此患上了创伤后应激障碍，这确实加剧了我的强迫症。

sentences.en: So that was after that, I was being incredibly protective about gerMs.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，我对细菌变得极其防备。

sentences.en: I mean, it's kind of natural in a way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在某种程度上是自然的。

sentences.en: I never want that to happen to me again.
sentences.zh: 我再也不想让那种事发生在我身上了。

sentences.en: So I am just going to be very careful.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是要非常小心。

sentences.en: But of course, it steps over into being a disorder when it kind of stops you functioning very well.
sentences.zh: 但当然，当它让你无法正常生活时，它就变成了一种障碍。

sentences.en: So I remember when I started my first jobs in London, it was things like touching door handles or buttons in the lift.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得当我开始在伦敦的第一份工作时，是触摸门把手或电梯按钮之类的事情。

sentences.en: And my particular favourite was having to shake people's hands.
sentences.zh: 我特别不喜欢的是不得不与人握手。

sentences.en: And I would actually try to actively avoid this by just holding bundles of stuff in my arms when I met people and just go,
sentences.zh: 我实际上会试图通过在见到人时怀里抱着一堆东西来积极避免这种情况，然后说，

sentences.en: Oh, I'm sorry, I can't shake your hand.
sentences.zh: “哦，抱歉，我不能和你握手。”

sentences.en: Because I didn't want them to feel bad because I knew it wasn't anything to do with them.
sentences.zh: 因为我不想让他们感到难过，因为我知道这与他们无关。

sentences.en: It was my thing.
sentences.zh: 这是我自己的问题。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, I didn't want to shake their hands.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，我还是不想和他们握手。

sentences.en: And I also carried antibacterial gel around with me everywhere so that if I was forced into doing any of these things,
sentences.zh: 而且我随身携带抗菌凝胶，这样如果我被迫做这些事情中的任何一件，

sentences.en: I would just surreptitiously clean my hands afterwards to feel a bit better.
sentences.zh: 我事后会偷偷地清洁双手，以感觉好一点。

sentences.en: And then the final bit of the story is that in my late 20s, and this is probably the most disturbing development,
sentences.zh: 故事的最后一部分是，在我 20 多岁的时候，这可能是最令人不安的发展，

sentences.en: I got full blown what I call responsibility OCD.
sentences.zh: 我患上了全面的、我称之为“责任强迫症”。

sentences.en: So it was basically an action or inaction of mine harming someone else.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上就是我的行为或不作为伤害了别人。

sentences.en: And I mean, literally, I could hardly get to work, I had to walk to work, and I could hardly get to work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的，我几乎无法去上班，我必须步行去上班，但我几乎无法去上班。

sentences.en: Because I would see broken glass and think, Oh, I better move that.
sentences.zh: 因为我会看到碎玻璃，心想，哦，我最好把它移开。

sentences.en: Otherwise, someone might fall over.
sentences.zh: 否则有人可能会摔倒。

sentences.en: And or there's a banana skin, there's the classic banana skin, or catching a stick or something in the corner of my eye and thinking,
sentences.zh: 或者有一个香蕉皮，经典的香蕉皮，或者眼角余光捕捉到一根棍子之类的东西，心想，

sentences.en: Oh, is it a needle?
sentences.zh: “哦，那是针吗？”

sentences.en: Do I need to work?
sentences.zh: “我需要处理吗？”

sentences.en: You know, all these things, it's, it becomes, it becomes all pervasive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所有这些事情，它变得，它变得无处不在。

sentences.en: And I, I know, I know, you'll know this, I get very frustrated when people say, Oh, I'm just a little bit OCD.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道，你会明白的，当人们说“哦，我有一点强迫症”时，我会感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And I know they don't mean it badly.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们不是恶意的。

sentences.en: But I'm like, OCD is not a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，强迫症可不是“一点点”。

sentences.en: OCD is like a rogue program in a computer that just takes over and stops the proper programs from running.
sentences.zh: 强迫症就像电脑里的流氓程序，它接管了一切，阻止了正常的程序运行。

sentences.en: So that, I suppose, is an overview of, of some of the issues that I've faced.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是我所面临的一些问题的概述。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so there we go.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是这样。

sentences.en: There's a starter for 10.
sentences.zh: 这只是个开场白。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm just really sorry that you kind of had to experience all of that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我真的很抱歉你不得不经历这一切。

sentences.en: And it obviously led to you, probably during treatment for your OCD, and your PTSD from the hospital stay led you to kind of explore and realise other things.
sentences.zh: 这显然导致了你——可能是在治疗强迫症和住院带来的创伤后应激障碍期间——开始探索并意识到其他一些事情。

sentences.en: And I just want to touch on the point that you'd said about, you know, I've no doubt that my dad loved me,
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈你提到的那一点，你说“我毫无疑问我爸爸爱我”，

sentences.en: but I think this is something that crops up quite often with my clients and those that my listeners will be working with as well.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这在我的客户以及我的听众所接触的人群中经常出现。

sentences.en: It's like, he loved you the best he could, but that doesn't mean that you didn't deserve more, you know, as a little baby, as a child, as even as an adult, you know,
sentences.zh: 就像是，他尽他所能地爱过你，但这并不意味着你作为婴儿、孩子，甚至作为成年人，不值得拥有更多，你知道的，

sentences.en: you deserve something more compassionate, more consistent, more that helped you thrive.
sentences.zh: 你值得拥有更富有同情心、更稳定、更能帮助你茁壮成长的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, so, you know, I don't want to, I don't want to discredit the love that you did feel from him, but actually, he did the best he could, but that wasn't, it wasn't good enough.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以，我不想否定你从他那里感受到的爱，但实际上，他尽力了，但这还不够好。

sentences.en: No, and I'll tell you something, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 不，我告诉你一件事，玛丽安。

sentences.en: So I'm an active Christian.
sentences.zh: 我是一名虔诚的基督徒。

sentences.en: I'm on a real journey about what forgiveness means in this particular instance, because it's really, really tough.
sentences.zh: 我正在经历一段关于在这种特定情况下“宽恕”意味着什么的真正旅程，因为这真的、真的很难。

sentences.en: I don't know whether I can say he did the best he could in the circumstances he was in, which is a phrase that, you know, I just don't, I can't even tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否能说他在那种情况下已经尽力了，这句话，我甚至无法对你说出口。

sentences.en: There were times latterly where he showed me, he actually admitted he was doing things intentionally when his guard was down.
sentences.zh: 后来有几次他向我展示了，他实际上承认当他放下防备时，他是故意做那些事的。

sentences.en: He actually, he actually died an alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 他实际上，他实际上死于酗酒。

sentences.en: So, but towards the end, he was, he always had an issue with alcohol, but it became much worse and more pronounced towards the end.
sentences.zh: 所以，但在最后阶段，他一直有酗酒问题，但在最后变得更严重、更明显了。

sentences.en: And I remember once he was picking on me about something and I said, surely you wouldn't make my life difficult in this way.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次他因为某事找我麻烦，我说，你肯定不会这样让我的生活变得困难吧。

sentences.en: Please, please don't.
sentences.zh: 求求你，求求你别这样。

sentences.en: He was threatening to do something that would make, make my life very tricky.
sentences.zh: 他当时威胁要做一些会让我的生活变得非常棘手的事情。

sentences.en: And he just looked at me and said, what, if I could get one over on you and I'll never forget, I just thought, my goodness,
sentences.zh: 他只是看着我说，怎么，如果我能占你上风呢？我永远不会忘记，我当时想，天哪，

sentences.en: you've just been really honest about actually being a bit premeditated about this.
sentences.zh: 你刚才真的很诚实地承认了这是蓄谋已久的。

sentences.en: So yeah, look, it is very,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，听着，这非常，

sentences.en: very tricky to deal with situations where people have caused you harm and kind of trying to figure out how much was unintentional and how much was intentional is, is tricky.
sentences.zh: 处理人们对你造成伤害的情况非常棘手，试图弄清楚有多少是无意的，有多少是有意的，这很困难。

sentences.en: Did you ever get a sense of what his upbringing was like and whether this was totally errant and totally rogue and all about him or whether he was kind of carrying on intergenerational,
sentences.zh: 你有没有感觉到他的成长环境是什么样的？这完全是离经叛道、完全是他个人的问题，还是他正在延续代际，

sentences.en: intergenerational trauma?
sentences.zh: 代际创伤？

sentences.en: It's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And actually, one of the things when I finally became aware of what the issue was, consciously aware, I put it aside for so long.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我最终意识到问题所在时，我是有意识地意识到的，我把它搁置了太久。

sentences.en: I remember my counsellor would kind of ask me about my parents because I think she had figured out very early on what the issue was in general terMs.
sentences.zh: 我记得我的咨询师会问我关于父母的事，因为我想她很早就从大体上弄清楚了问题所在。

sentences.en: And I would just say, oh, no, don't look over there.
sentences.zh: 而我只会说，哦，不，别看那边。

sentences.en: Why are you asking me about that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要问我那个？

sentences.en: Stop asking me about that.
sentences.zh: 别再问我那个了。

sentences.en: And then eventually I became aware of what was going on and began to kind of fight against it, actually, a little bit.
sentences.zh: 后来我终于意识到了发生了什么，并开始有点反抗它了。

sentences.en: Anyway, what I'm struggling with now, so my mother died 10 years ago and then my father died last year, sadly, after we had estranged because of his alcoholism.
sentences.zh: 总之，我现在挣扎的是，我母亲10年前去世了，然后我父亲去年去世了，遗憾的是，在我们因为他的酗酒而疏远之后。

sentences.en: Were your parents together until your mum died?
sentences.zh: 你父母在你母亲去世前一直在一起吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, they were.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们在一起。

sentences.en: And but there's basically no one left.
sentences.zh: 但基本上已经没有人了。

sentences.en: There are very, very few people who know about my paSt.
sentences.zh: 很少有人知道我的过去。

sentences.en: There are some people who remember me as a child with my parents.
sentences.zh: 有些人记得我小时候和父母在一起的样子。

sentences.en: And I've actually gone back to some of them and asked them, can I chat to you honestly just to get your impressions?
sentences.zh: 我实际上回去找过他们中的一些人，问他们，我能诚实地和你聊聊，听听你的印象吗？

sentences.en: And basically all of them in their different ways have verified my story.
sentences.zh: 基本上他们每个人都以不同的方式证实了我的故事。

sentences.en: Obviously, they didn't see my father behind closed doors in a family situation, but they definitely saw that difficult streak in him.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们没有在家庭内部看到我父亲关起门来的样子，但他们确实看到了他性格中困难的一面。

sentences.en: And they had.
sentences.zh: 他们确实看到了。

sentences.en: So I've got that validation, which is helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以我得到了那种验证，这很有帮助。

sentences.en: But when it comes to going further back, there is no one I can talk to.
sentences.zh: 但当谈到更久远的事情时，没有人可以谈论。

sentences.en: What I can say is that I do not think that he had a difficult childhood.
sentences.zh: 我能说的是，我不认为他有一个困难的童年。

sentences.en: I mean, I think everyone has aspects from what I've read.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，据我所读，我认为每个人都有这方面的因素。

sentences.en: And I'm obviously not not an expert in this.
sentences.zh: 我显然不是这方面的专家。

sentences.en: But when you come to narcissism, one of the backgrounds they talk about is where a child is put on a pedestal and that that can cause those kind of narcissistic things to come.
sentences.zh: 但谈到自恋时，他们谈论的背景之一是孩子被捧上神坛，这可能会导致那些自恋的东西出现。

sentences.en: And tendencies to come out.
sentences.zh: 以及倾向显露出来。

sentences.en: And I think with him, he was definitely the favorite of the three children in his family.
sentences.zh: 我认为对他来说，他绝对是他家三个孩子中最受宠的一个。

sentences.en: And that was demonstrated in a number of ways.
sentences.zh: 这一点在很多方面都有体现。

sentences.en: So my my gut feeling is that it was more that.
sentences.zh: 所以我的直觉是，更多是因为那个。

sentences.en: And that's still an issue that he had to deal with, because my suspicion is that he was kind of told the world is your oyster.
sentences.zh: 那仍然是他必须处理的问题，因为我怀疑他被告知世界是你的囊中之物。

sentences.en: You're really special.
sentences.zh: 你真的很特别。

sentences.en: You're going to go and do amazing things.
sentences.zh: 你会去成就一番惊人的事业。

sentences.en: And in fact, he did go and do really, you know, amazing things, went to university, I think the first in the family and all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他确实去做了非常惊人的事情，上了大学，我想是家里第一个，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: I then have pieced together that he had quite a lot of disappointments, really quite difficult disappointments that came his way when I was a toddler.
sentences.zh: 后来我拼凑出，他在我蹒跚学步时遇到了很多失望，非常困难的失望。

sentences.en: Actually, a lot of things that happened all at once.
sentences.zh: 实际上，很多事情同时发生了。

sentences.en: So I just piecing it together.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是把它们拼凑起来。

sentences.en: My my kind of working hypothesis, if you like, is that he felt that everything was brilliant in the world and he could do what he wanted.
sentences.zh: 我的工作假设，如果你愿意的话，是他觉得世界上一切都很棒，他可以做他想做的事。

sentences.en: And then he suddenly got shocks to the system, which showed him that wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 然后他突然受到了系统的冲击，这向他表明事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And all of those things combined were probably what led to some of his more problematic behavior.
sentences.zh: 所有这些加在一起，可能导致了他一些更具破坏性的行为。

sentences.en: I don't know if you think that sounds feasible.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否认为这听起来可行。

sentences.en: But yeah.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it certainly sounds feasible.
sentences.zh: 是的，这听起来确实可行。

sentences.en: And often when we're working with people who have got a complex trauma diagnosis or complex trauma presentation, should we say,
sentences.zh: 通常当我们与患有复杂创伤诊断或复杂创伤表现的人一起工作时，我们应该说，

sentences.en: which is like a cluster of different kind of presenting problems that we might well go through shortly.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一系列不同的表现问题，我们可能很快就会经历这些。

sentences.en: There's sometimes been in terms of making a therapeutic difference,
sentences.zh: 有时在产生治疗效果方面，

sentences.en: it can be really important that somebody's had some caregiver or someone in their life that's been a good or good enough figure.
sentences.zh: 有一个照顾者或生命中某个“足够好”的人物是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Have you had that?
sentences.zh: 你有过这样的人吗？

sentences.en: And was that your mom or was she kind of complicated too?
sentences.zh: 那是你妈妈吗？还是她也比较复杂？

sentences.en: So this is a really interesting question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I, again, my mother was a beautiful, wonderful person and she wanted children more than anything in the world.
sentences.zh: 我再次重申，我母亲是一个美丽、美好的人，她比世界上任何东西都更想要孩子。

sentences.en: And that's what everyone who knows her from the past tells me.
sentences.zh: 过去认识她的每个人都这样告诉我。

sentences.en: She wanted you more than anything.
sentences.zh: 她比任何东西都更想要你。

sentences.en: And I was the only child who survived.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一幸存的孩子。

sentences.en: There were quite a lot of miscarriages and difficulties.
sentences.zh: 有过很多次流产和困难。

sentences.en: I, she was definitely an amazing mother in my younger years.
sentences.zh: 在我年幼的时候，她绝对是一位了不起的母亲。

sentences.en: And the bit which I am coming to terms with now, which is harder.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在接受的部分，比较困难。

sentences.en: And this is not a reflection on her, but she was in a very difficult relationship with my father and she was so loyal to him.
sentences.zh: 这并不是对她的评价，但她和我父亲的关系非常困难，她对他非常忠诚。

sentences.en: Like she was unbelievably loyal to him.
sentences.zh: 就像她对他有着难以置信的忠诚。

sentences.en: But it took its toll on her, which I can now see.
sentences.zh: 但这让她付出了代价，我现在能看出来了。

sentences.en: So I've now realised, well, I physically lost my mother 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在意识到，好吧，我10年前失去了母亲。

sentences.en: Actually, I probably really lost her about 20 years ago, because when I look back, she just changed.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我可能在20年前就真正失去了她，因为当我回顾过去时，她变了。

sentences.en: She became a bit of a shadow of her former self.
sentences.zh: 她变得有点像以前自己的影子。

sentences.en: And that is something I've only understood more recently.
sentences.zh: 这是我最近才理解的事情。

sentences.en: So, yes, I think she was the foundation for making this easier for me than it might otherwise have been.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为她是让我比原本可能的情况更容易度过难关的基础。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: And one of the ways I think that's played out is, you know, you often see children who've been through traumatic experiences in their childhood.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一种体现方式是，你知道，你经常看到童年经历过创伤的孩子。

sentences.en: They might then go and get a partner who is also difficult and displays similar problematic behaviours and that, you know, you can get into a bit of a vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 他们后来可能会找一个同样困难、表现出类似问题行为的伴侣，你知道，这会陷入一种恶性循环。

sentences.en: Well, I've questioned quite a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我质疑过很多次。

sentences.en: Why did I marry such a wonderful person?
sentences.zh: 为什么我嫁给了这么好的人？

sentences.en: Which I did.
sentences.zh: 我确实嫁给了他。

sentences.en: I mean, he is just a wonderful, loving husband.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他真是一个很棒、很有爱心的丈夫。

sentences.en: We're coming up to our 20th wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 我们快要迎来结婚20周年纪念日了。

sentences.en: He married me not knowing what he was getting himself into in terms of the family dynamic and got a bit of a shock.
sentences.zh: 他娶我时并不知道他要面对什么样的家庭动态，结果有点震惊。

sentences.en: But I think I think maybe that was a sign that I did have an understanding of what good looked like.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这也许是一个迹象，表明我确实了解什么是“好”。

sentences.en: And I was actually seeking it and found it, luckily, which was a huge part of my recovery.
sentences.zh: 我实际上是在寻找它并找到了它，幸运的是，这是我康复过程中的重要部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm really pleased that you've been able to marry into a family that's predictable, consistent, safe, calm, respectful all the time, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很高兴你能嫁入一个可预测、一致、安全、冷静、始终尊重的家庭，希望如此。

sentences.en: And that really makes such a difference.
sentences.zh: 那真的带来了很大的不同。

sentences.en: I don't know if you went on to become a parent yourself, but, you know, I think it just helps you really appreciate what it was that you didn't have.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你后来是否也成为了父母，但你知道，我认为这有助于你真正体会到你所没有的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，你说得完全对。

sentences.en: Actually, my husband and I chose not to have children.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我和我丈夫选择不要孩子。

sentences.en: And that's always quite a multifaceted decision.
sentences.zh: 这总是一个多方面的决定。

sentences.en: But I will say, if I'm being really honest, I just knew I was not in a place to be a good mother.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，如果我真的很诚实，我只是知道我没有处于一个能成为好母亲的状态。

sentences.en: And that that was part of it.
sentences.zh: 那是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: I could instinctively.
sentences.zh: 我可以本能地感觉到。

sentences.en: I just thought I'm all over the place.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我乱七八糟的。

sentences.en: How on earth if I can't look after myself?
sentences.zh: 如果我连自己都照顾不好，怎么可能照顾孩子？

sentences.en: Now, I'm not saying that would be the case for everyone.
sentences.zh: 现在，我并不是说这对每个人都一样。

sentences.en: I think everyone makes their own decisions for a bunch of reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都出于各种原因做出自己的决定。

sentences.en: I think I just felt it.
sentences.zh: 我想我只是感觉到了。

sentences.en: I also just didn't really want it.
sentences.zh: 我也只是真的不想要。

sentences.en: And I was able to be honest about that and go, well, if it's not really something I am wanting and I think it's going to be a struggle,
sentences.zh: 我能够诚实地面对这一点，并说，好吧，如果这不是我真正想要的，而且我认为这会是一种挣扎，

sentences.en: then maybe that's not a good thing to do.
sentences.zh: 那么也许这不是一件好事。

sentences.en: Whereas I think with other people, I can see they think, well, this may be challenging, but it's something I really want.
sentences.zh: 而我认为对于其他人，我可以看到他们认为，好吧，这可能具有挑战性，但这是我真正想要的。

sentences.en: And therefore, it'll help me.
sentences.zh: 因此，它会帮助我。

sentences.en: That'll enable me to step up and do, you know, do new things and learn new things and new ways of being.
sentences.zh: 那将使我能够站出来，做新的事情，学习新的东西和新的生活方式。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think at the heart of it was probably I didn't really want it and therefore decided it wasn't it wasn't worth it for me, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为核心可能是我真的不想要，因此决定这对我来说不值得，如果这说得通的话。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 说得通。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, with children, I think you need to really, really want it because, you know, they'll wreck your life.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，有了孩子，你需要真正、真正地想要它，因为，你知道，他们会毁了你的生活。

sentences.en: I've got two of the beasts, you know, and I had them slightly later in life, probably not that late in terms of modern, but I had my first one when I was 31.
sentences.zh: 我有两个这样的“小野兽”，你知道，我生他们稍微晚了一点，以现代标准来看可能不算太晚，但我31岁时生了第一个。

sentences.en: And by that time, I'd had such a wonderful life.
sentences.zh: 到那时，我已经拥有了如此精彩的生活。

sentences.en: You know, I'd been traveling.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直在旅行。

sentences.en: I was a professionally qualified psychologiSt. You know, I was married.
sentences.zh: 我是一名拥有专业资格的心理学家。你知道，我结婚了。

sentences.en: I'd had many lovely adventures, you know, lots of funny, silly times, lots of serious times, lots of time to really work on myself.
sentences.zh: 我经历过许多可爱的冒险，你知道，很多有趣、愚蠢的时光，很多严肃的时光，很多真正自我提升的时间。

sentences.en: And I mindfully chose to burn all that to the ground and become a parent and and do something different.
sentences.zh: 我清醒地选择烧毁这一切，成为一名父母，做一些不同的事情。

sentences.en: You know, the next generation of my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我生命的下一阶段。

sentences.en: But you have to really, really want to do that.
sentences.zh: 但你必须真正、真正地想要那样做。

sentences.en: You can't really be a little bit unsure because it is such a big choice.
sentences.zh: 你不能有一点不确定，因为这是一个如此重大的选择。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, by contrast, what I would say is I kind of feel like my 20s and my 30s were kind of stolen from me.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，相比之下，我想说的是，我感觉我的20多岁和30多岁像是被偷走了。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: I know that sounds a bit negative, but it really is how it felt that some of the physically best years of my life.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来有点消极，但这确实是我当时的感觉，那是我身体状况最好的几年。

sentences.en: I was just so unhappy.
sentences.zh: 我当时太不开心了。

sentences.en: And it's not that I didn't have nice times, but I certainly didn't feel like I could take on anything else.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我没有过美好的时光，但我肯定觉得我无法承担任何其他事情。

sentences.en: I could just about keep my career going.
sentences.zh: 我只能勉强维持我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And I had a successful career, but it felt precarious to me because of everything that was going on in the background.
sentences.zh: 我有一个成功的职业，但因为背景中发生的一切，我觉得它岌岌可危。

sentences.en: Yeah, it sounds like you're already at capacity.
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来你当时已经处于极限了。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to touch on what you'd said about your mum, really.
sentences.zh: 我只是想谈谈你刚才说的关于你妈妈的事。

sentences.en: And I think what you nicely described there is that sometimes for a really deep depression,
sentences.zh: 我认为你刚才描述得很好，有时对于非常严重的抑郁症，

sentences.en: it can occur because someone feels like they can't take control or they're not able to take control.
sentences.zh: 可能是因为某人觉得他们无法掌控，或者他们没有能力掌控。

sentences.en: And so the other kind of variable that they can do is to just kind of withdraw and stop caring and kind of let everything happen around them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们能做的另一种选择就是退缩，不再关心，让周围的一切顺其自然。

sentences.en: And, you know, I can't pathologise your mum nor what I want to, but from what you're saying, it sounds like that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我不能给你的母亲下病理诊断，我也不想这样做，但从你所说的来看，听起来就是发生了这种情况。

sentences.en: So you kind of she retreated from you.
sentences.zh: 所以她从你身边退缩了。

sentences.en: She retreated within herself in order to just carry on showing up in that in that home and in that relationship.
sentences.zh: 她退缩到自己的内心世界，只是为了继续在那个家里、在那段关系中维持现状。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that is a very good description of what happened.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是对所发生之事的非常好的描述。

sentences.en: And she did have depressive tendencies, which, you know, were genetic.
sentences.zh: 她确实有抑郁倾向，你知道的，那是遗传的。

sentences.en: They came from her father.
sentences.zh: 来自她父亲。

sentences.en: He served in the war.
sentences.zh: 他曾服过兵役。

sentences.en: He came back, you know, very, very affected by that.
sentences.zh: 他回来后，你知道的，受到的影响非常、非常深。

sentences.en: And so there's no doubt I picked up a bunch of fear and anxiety as a young kid as well, just because that was kind of hanging around.
sentences.zh: 所以毫无疑问，我小时候也吸收了很多恐惧和焦虑，仅仅是因为那种氛围一直笼罩着我们。

sentences.en: And, you know, there were there were just unfortunate times and they were rare.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，确实有一些不幸的时刻，但它们很少见。

sentences.en: They were very rare.
sentences.zh: 非常罕见。

sentences.en: But there were times where she would turn and blame me for things that were going wrong.
sentences.zh: 但有时她会转过头来，把事情出错的原因归咎于我。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, and at the time, I didn't know what to do with them.
sentences.zh: 当时我真的不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I just felt like I'd been kind of slapped in the face.
sentences.zh: 我感觉就像被人扇了一记耳光。

sentences.en: But now I look back and I realise it was it was just again, it was just a lashing out because she was trapped in a situation.
sentences.zh: 但现在回想起来，我意识到那不过是她被困在某种境地中而发泄情绪罢了。

sentences.en: But as I say, so loyal.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所说，她非常忠诚。

sentences.en: And I think it was a different age.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为那是一个不同的时代。

sentences.en: I think that is part of it as well, which I have begun to come to terms with is just I think, you know, nowadays society is more accepting of couples splitting up
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是原因的一部分，我已经开始接受这一点，那就是我认为，你知道，现在的社会对夫妻分道扬镳更加包容了，

sentences.en: and of there being a bit more empowerment to do that and perhaps a bit more support out there to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且人们更有能力去这样做，也许外界也有更多的支持来帮助他们这样做。

sentences.en: Not so much the case, you know, roll back a few decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年前可不是这样。

sentences.en: So that's something else, because sometimes I thought to myself, why didn't why didn't she leave him?
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一回事，因为有时我会想，为什么她不离开他呢？

sentences.en: Why didn't she protect me and get me out of it?
sentences.zh: 为什么她不保护我，带我脱离那种环境？

sentences.en: Couldn't she see how damaging it was?
sentences.zh: 难道她看不出那有多大的伤害吗？

sentences.en: And again, I can't have answers to all these questions, which is quite hard.
sentences.zh: 同样，我无法得到所有这些问题的答案，这很难受。

sentences.en: But it is just I think for me, you'll know with OCD, a lot of it is about certainty.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对我来说，你了解强迫症（OCD），很大程度上是关于确定性。

sentences.en: You want to have certainty about things.
sentences.zh: 你想要对事情有确定感。

sentences.en: I want to know in my case, I want to be sure that I'm safe and everyone else is safe.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我想确定我和其他人都是安全的。

sentences.en: And with coming to terms with my past,
sentences.zh: 而在与过去和解的过程中，

sentences.en: I've had to realise I cannot have certainty and I have to come to peace with that and get the best possible understanding I can to help me move forward without getting obsessed about all the details that I can't know about.
sentences.zh: 我不得不意识到我无法获得确定性，我必须与此达成和解，并尽可能获得最好的理解，以帮助我继续前行，而不是纠结于那些我无法知晓的细节。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对如此。

sentences.en: And thinking about what is kind of complex post-traumatic stress disorder, what I find is that with many of the clients I work with,
sentences.zh: 考虑到什么是复杂的创伤后应激障碍（CPTSD），我发现我接触的许多客户中，

sentences.en: they don't even necessarily realise they've had a traumatic childhood.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不一定意识到自己有过创伤性的童年。

sentences.en: Because actually, when we look at kind of the markers for it, the points add up quite quickly for things that might look like quite inconsequential things as standalone.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，当我们审视相关的指标时，那些单独看起来可能无关紧要的事情，加在一起很快就构成了问题。

sentences.en: You know, some of them are inconsequential, some of them are not, obviously.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一些确实无关紧要，但显然有些并非如此。

sentences.en: But people might say to me, I've always just felt a bit anxious, unsafe, depressed.
sentences.zh: 但人们可能会对我说，我一直觉得自己有点焦虑、不安全、抑郁。

sentences.en: I think it's just me, like, you know, it's just my fault.
sentences.zh: 我想这只是我自己的问题，你知道，这只是我的错。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know why I've always been this way.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不知道为什么我一直都是这样。

sentences.en: And actually, when we come to look at their experiences, you know, if we're looking at a kind of a rough and ready measure, like the adverse childhood experiences scale,
sentences.zh: 而实际上，当我们审视他们的经历时，你知道，如果我们看一个粗略的衡量标准，比如不良童年经历量表（ACE量表），

sentences.en: the ACE scale, or it's looking at 10 key questions, they might be scoring six or seven on the scale with the threshold for indicative CPTSD being four.
sentences.zh: ACE量表，它考察10个关键问题，他们在这个量表上可能会得6或7分，而CPTSD的指标阈值是4分。

sentences.en: And when you're able to just explain that to them, it can be like light and day, you know, in terms of, that's not the right term, is it?
sentences.zh: 当你能向他们解释清楚这一点时，那简直是天壤之别，你知道，那个词不是这么说的，对吧？

sentences.en: What's the term?
sentences.zh: 那个词是什么？

sentences.en: Night and day.
sentences.zh: 天壤之别。

sentences.en: Night and day.
sentences.zh: 天壤之别。

sentences.en: Night and day.
sentences.zh: 天壤之别。

sentences.en: We'll leave that in just to show that we're human.
sentences.zh: 我们保留这段对话，正好展示我们也是凡人。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's it can be transformational for them.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这对他们来说可能是变革性的。

sentences.en: Just that one recognition that actually, oh, there's a reason why I feel like I do.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是那种认知——噢，原来我之所以有这种感觉是有原因的。

sentences.en: And actually, this makes a lot of sense for the way that I feel and for then helping them feel more compassion for their younger self,
sentences.zh: 实际上，这让我对自己的感受有了合理的解释，进而帮助他们对自己年幼时的自己产生更多的同情，

sentences.en: who they might well have been kind of dragging around with them, hating, actually, and loathing what their experiences were like and blaming them for their experiences.
sentences.zh: 那个他们可能一直带着、甚至憎恨的自己，实际上，他们厌恶自己曾经的经历，并因此责怪当年的自己。

sentences.en: Like, how's that been for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是怎样的体验？

sentences.en: Again, a masterful explanation there, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 又是一次精彩的解释，玛丽安。

sentences.en: I mean, I think for me, I was just in rock solid denial.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为对我来说，我当时完全处于坚决否认的状态。

sentences.en: So if someone, including my counselor, so I went to my counselor for my OCD because I, with the responsibility OCD, I literally thought I was losing my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人，包括我的咨询师——我因为强迫症去找咨询师，因为责任型强迫症，我真的以为自己要疯了。

sentences.en: And on top of that, I already had the hygiene OCD, spider phobia.
sentences.zh: 而且除此之外，我还有卫生强迫症和蜘蛛恐惧症。

sentences.en: I haven't even mentioned to you the fact that I have chronic insomnia and have done all my adult life still.
sentences.zh: 我甚至还没跟你提过我有慢性失眠症，而且整个成年生活一直如此。

sentences.en: That's probably the longest lasting that's still with me now.
sentences.zh: 那可能是持续时间最长、至今仍伴随着我的问题。

sentences.en: And it'd be interesting to see how that evolves.
sentences.zh: 看看它如何演变会很有趣。

sentences.en: But I just thought I was going mad and I thought it was my fault.
sentences.zh: 但我当时真的以为自己疯了，而且认为是我的错。

sentences.en: I just thought I'm a crazy person.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我是一个疯子。

sentences.en: I don't know what else to say.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还能说什么。

sentences.en: And she obviously knew that she couldn't push me too far.
sentences.zh: 她显然知道她不能把我逼得太紧。

sentences.en: The very interesting fact was my very first married Christmas, my husband watched my father blow up at me and blame me for something in a horrible argument.
sentences.zh: 一个非常有趣的事实是，我婚后的第一个圣诞节，我丈夫看着我父亲对我大发雷霆，在一场可怕的争吵中把事情归咎于我。

sentences.en: He always used to blow up just before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 他总是习惯在圣诞节前大发雷霆。

sentences.en: And then we all had to recover because my mother loved Christmas.
sentences.zh: 然后我们都得努力恢复，因为我母亲热爱圣诞节。

sentences.en: And so we all had to make it work.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都得设法让节日继续。

sentences.en: And it was it was hideous.
sentences.zh: 那真是太可怕了。

sentences.en: And apparently and I don't even remember this after my father had gone away and my husband was just sitting there stunned thinking, what what was that?
sentences.zh: 显然——我甚至都不记得这个了——在我父亲走后，我丈夫坐在那里惊呆了，心想，那到底是什么？

sentences.en: And I said to him, I know this is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，我知道这是不对的。

sentences.en: I know it's not healthy, but I have to stick around for my mother.
sentences.zh: 我知道这不健康，但我必须为了我母亲留下来。

sentences.en: I cannot leave her.
sentences.zh: 我不能离开她。

sentences.en: Now, after that, apparently I didn't say anything for years.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，显然我有好几年什么都没说。

sentences.en: And in fact, my husband then went to see my counselor as well.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我丈夫后来也去看了我的咨询师。

sentences.en: She was actually our minister, our church.
sentences.zh: 她其实是我们教会的牧师。

sentences.en: And he apparently talked to her at one point about wanting to just take me out of the situation because he could see how damaging it was.
sentences.zh: 显然他有一次和她谈过，想把我从那种环境中带走，因为他能看出那有多大的伤害。

sentences.en: Every time I went back, it's like I was taking another step back, even if I may have taken some tentative steps forward in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 每次我回去，就像又倒退了一步，即使我在此期间可能已经尝试着迈出了一些步子。

sentences.en: And she just apparently said to him, if you try to pull her out too soon, if you force her into making a choice when she's not ready, she may make the choice you're not expecting.
sentences.zh: 她显然只是对他说，如果你试图太快把她拉出来，如果你强迫她在还没准备好时做出选择，她可能会做出你意想不到的选择。

sentences.en: And that may just be completely, you know, not what actually what she wants in the long term either, but she might pick her parents.
sentences.zh: 那可能完全不是她长远来看真正想要的，但她可能会选择她的父母。

sentences.en: So I was just in total denial and it was a very gentle process.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时完全处于否认状态，那是一个非常温和的过程。

sentences.en: But I think in the end, I would say I.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最后，我会说我……

sentences.en: He began to just do more and more outrageous things.
sentences.zh: 他开始做出越来越多离谱的事情。

sentences.en: And some of it was brought on by my mother's illness.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是由我母亲的病情引起的。

sentences.en: She had cancer and it was it was, you know, as these things are not pleasant at all.
sentences.zh: 她得了癌症，你知道的，这些事情一点也不好受。

sentences.en: And it's understandable that we would find that difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这很困难是可以理解的。

sentences.en: But he actually drove me out of the house just before midnight on Christmas Eve, the year she had had her operation.
sentences.zh: 但在她手术那年的平安夜午夜前，他竟然把我赶出了家门。

sentences.en: I mean, I literally I was walking down a dark road in the middle of nowhere in Scotland with nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我当时真的走在苏格兰荒郊野外的一条黑路上，无处可去。

sentences.en: My husband was with his with his family and I thought I wasn't going back.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫当时和他家人在一起，我以为我不会再回去了。

sentences.en: And then my father eventually picked me up in the car.
sentences.zh: 后来我父亲开车把我接了回去。

sentences.en: We didn't say anything, just drove back.
sentences.zh: 我们什么也没说，就开车回去了。

sentences.en: And I will never forget.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: We got to the driveway, he stopped the car and he looked at me and he said, well, Alexandra, are you ready to give in yet?
sentences.zh: 到了车道上，他停下车看着我说，好吧，亚历山德拉，你准备好屈服了吗？

sentences.en: And I just thought, I can't believe you actually came to get me.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，我真不敢相信你竟然来接我。

sentences.en: You saw that I was so badly affected that I actually walked out of the house and you're asking me if I'm ready to give in.
sentences.zh: 你明明看到我受了那么大的打击，以至于我真的走出了家门，而你却问我是否准备好屈服了。

sentences.en: And I said no.
sentences.zh: 我说没有。

sentences.en: And that was a profound moment for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一个深刻的时刻。

sentences.en: I was like, I don't care if Christmas is messed up this year.
sentences.zh: 我心想，我才不管今年的圣诞节是不是搞砸了。

sentences.en: I am not giving in on this ridiculous argument that you have created out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会在你凭空捏造的这种荒谬争吵中屈服。

sentences.en: So we went into the house.
sentences.zh: 于是我们进了屋。

sentences.en: I went to my room thinking, goodness knows where this is now headed.
sentences.zh: 我回到房间，心想，天知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: And eventually my mum came and knocked on the door and said, your father would like to see you.
sentences.zh: 最后我妈妈来敲门说，你父亲想见你。

sentences.en: And I said, really?
sentences.zh: 我说，真的吗？

sentences.en: And went downstairs and suddenly I found myself sitting on his knee.
sentences.zh: 我下楼后，突然发现自己坐在他的膝盖上。

sentences.en: I'm way too old for that now, but I'm sitting on his knee and he's saying, Alexandra, you do know that I love you, don't you?
sentences.zh: 我现在已经太大了，不适合那样了，但我坐在他膝盖上，他说，亚历山德拉，你知道我爱你，对吧？

sentences.en: And my mother, in one of her wonderful moments of clarity, just looked at him and said, I don't think she does know that right now, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我母亲在她难得清醒的时刻之一，看着他说，老实说，我觉得她现在并不确定。

sentences.en: And I tell that story just to say his behaviour got worse as I got older.
sentences.zh: 我讲这个故事只是为了说明，随着我长大，他的行为变得更糟了。

sentences.en: I don't think he could cope with me being an independent human being who voiced my own opinions if they were not similar to his.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他无法接受我成为一个有独立思想的人，如果我的意见与他不一致的话。

sentences.en: And when he became more extreme and as I was growing in confidence and had my husband and began to see other models, I just began to say no.
sentences.zh: 当他变得更加极端，而我越来越自信，有了丈夫并开始看到其他生活模式时，我开始说不。

sentences.en: And over time, that got to a point where I could say that I was my own human being and could see that that behaviour was not accurate, not good,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我终于可以说我是一个独立的人了，也能看出那种行为是不恰当的、不好的、

sentences.en: not healthy and not really what a father should be doing with his child.
sentences.zh: 不健康的，也不是一个父亲对待孩子应有的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, when we're parents or even, I don't know, I care about everybody.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我们为人父母时，或者甚至，我不知道，我关心每一个人。

sentences.en: I want everyone to be safe.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个人都是安全的。

sentences.en: I don't want you to be vulnerable walking alone in the dark at midnight on Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 我不希望你在平安夜午夜独自走在黑暗中感到脆弱。

sentences.en: Like, I don't want that for anybody, let alone my own children, you know, to think that that's happening or happened.
sentences.zh: 我不希望任何人经历这些，更不用说我自己的孩子了，你知道，想到这些正在发生或曾经发生过。

sentences.en: And people are knowingly doing that.
sentences.zh: 而且人们是明知故犯。

sentences.en: It's just, you know, it's just horrendous, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真是，你知道，太可怕了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's tough to look back on.
sentences.zh: 是的，回首往事很难受。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting, actually, as I have decided to talk about my story and to share it, to raise awareness,
sentences.zh: 而且很有趣的是，当我决定讲述我的故事并分享它以提高人们的意识时，

sentences.en: because I still do not believe that emotional abuse is as well understood as other forms of abuse.
sentences.zh: 因为我仍然不认为情感虐待像其他形式的虐待那样被人们充分理解。

sentences.en: I mean, you're absolutely correct.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: The ACE study shows how, you know, how difficult these different experiences are for children.
sentences.zh: ACE研究显示了这些不同的经历对孩子来说是多么困难。

sentences.en: And yet I still think there's a difference in perception in people's minds.
sentences.zh: 然而我仍然认为人们的认知存在差异。

sentences.en: And sometimes they just think, oh, well, just toughen up.
sentences.zh: 有时他们只是想，噢，坚强点吧。

sentences.en: It's just words.
sentences.zh: 那只是些话而已。

sentences.en: What are you worrying about?
sentences.zh: 你在担心什么？

sentences.en: And it's like so much more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 但这比那复杂得多。

sentences.en: So I've started to share my story.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始分享我的故事。

sentences.en: And I'll be honest with you, there are the really supportive people.
sentences.zh: 老实说，确实有一些非常支持我的人。

sentences.en: There are then the people who just don't say anything to me and they're just not comfortable to say anything.
sentences.zh: 也有一些人什么都不对我说，他们只是觉得不自在，不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: And then I've had a few people actually criticise it, which has been fascinating.
sentences.zh: 还有几个人实际上批评了我的做法，这很有意思。

sentences.en: But I am at least in a strong enough place now that I can say, well, fine, you can hold that view if you want to.
sentences.zh: 但我现在至少处于一个足够强大的位置，可以说，好吧，没关系，如果你想那样看，那是你的事。

sentences.en: But I am doing this not to shame my father.
sentences.zh: 但我这样做并不是为了羞辱我的父亲。

sentences.en: I, you know, I'm not doing it for that reason.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是为了那个原因。

sentences.en: I'm doing it because there's no other family member to be distressed by what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 我这样做是因为没有其他家庭成员会因为我的话而感到困扰。

sentences.en: You know, there are no siblings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没有兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: There are no other close family members.
sentences.zh: 也没有其他亲近的家庭成员。

sentences.en: So I am actually at liberty to tell this story honestly.
sentences.zh: 所以我实际上可以自由地诚实地讲述这个故事。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, I already have proof that people are coming to me and saying this is really valuable.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，我已经有了证据，人们来找我说这真的很有价值。

sentences.en: So that's that's kind of the essence of why I'm doing it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我做这件事的初衷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And more and more podcasts and kind of, you know, media appearances that you get.
sentences.zh: 而且你参加的播客和媒体节目越多，

sentences.en: You know, it gives people more and more opportunity to really see what this has been like and what this is like.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这给了人们越来越多的机会去真正了解这曾经是什么样，以及现在是什么样。

sentences.en: I understand your dad was reasonably high profile as well.
sentences.zh: 我听说你父亲也相当引人注目。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was a member of parliament for nearly 20 years.
sentences.zh: 是的，他做了近20年的国会议员。

sentences.en: So and I think it's really interesting because I think he was kind of drawn to that kind of career because, you know, there's a bit of there's a lot of antagonism there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这很有趣，因为我觉得他被那种职业吸引，是因为，你知道，那里有很多对抗。

sentences.en: It's just I'm not saying by the way that all MPs like that.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我并不是说所有的议员都那样。

sentences.en: I've actually met quite a lot of members of parliament because as I was growing up, it was the environment I was in.
sentences.zh: 我实际上见过很多国会议员，因为在我成长过程中，那就是我所处的环境。

sentences.en: And there are some really amazing people who want to serve us and and, you know, help lead the country.
sentences.zh: 有一些非常了不起的人，他们想要服务我们，并帮助领导这个国家。

sentences.en: But I do think that element of antagonism is just an interesting one.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为那种对抗的因素很有意思。

sentences.en: And I think he thrived on it, to be honest, to some extent.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为他在某种程度上以此为乐。

sentences.en: And yeah, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不确定。

sentences.en: Hoping he wasn't ever minister for children.
sentences.zh: 希望他从来没当过儿童事务大臣。

sentences.en: No, no, he did not become a minister.
sentences.zh: 不，不，他没有成为牧师。

sentences.en: But yeah.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, you know, I think it's been a really illuminating conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我觉得这是一次非常有启发性的谈话。

sentences.en: I feel like it probably could have been two or three podcast episodes to really, you know, do this topic justice.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能需要两到三期播客节目才能真正地，你知道，公正地探讨这个话题。

sentences.en: But tell us a little bit about your book.
sentences.zh: 但请跟我们聊聊你的书吧。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: So, well, I've obviously told you a little bit about Christmas being difficult for me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我显然已经跟你提过一点，圣诞节对我来说一直很艰难。

sentences.en: And I think that is a story you hear replicated quite a lot because families are thrown together.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这是一个你经常会听到的故事，因为家庭成员被迫聚在一起。

sentences.en: And Christmas, therefore, becomes a bit of a flashpoint if there are family difficulties.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果家庭之间存在矛盾，圣诞节就会成为一个爆发点。

sentences.en: I, my mother loved Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我，我母亲很爱圣诞节。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我也很爱。

sentences.en: All the beautiful stuff.
sentences.zh: 所有美好的事物。

sentences.en: But I got to the point where because all of these difficult things had happened year after year after year.
sentences.zh: 但我到了一个地步，因为这些困难的事情年复一年地发生。

sentences.en: I just retreated from it altogether.
sentences.zh: 我干脆完全退出了。

sentences.en: And this was round about the time I estranged from my father as well, where the relationship with him was kind of getting to the point where it was falling over.
sentences.zh: 那大约也是我与父亲疏远的时候，我和他的关系当时已经到了濒临破裂的地步。

sentences.en: And there was the year I just didn't did nothing.
sentences.zh: 那一年我什么都没做。

sentences.en: We had no tree.
sentences.zh: 我们没有圣诞树。

sentences.en: We had no presents.
sentences.zh: 我们没有礼物。

sentences.en: We didn't visit family.
sentences.zh: 我们没有拜访家人。

sentences.en: It was just my husband and me in our house not doing Christmas.
sentences.zh: 只有我和我丈夫在家里，不过圣诞节。

sentences.en: And in fact, on Christmas Day, we just went out for a walk on a rather wet Scottish day to a rather wet Scottish waterfall just to just to do something.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在圣诞节那天，我们只是去了一个潮湿的苏格兰地方散步，去了一个潮湿的苏格兰瀑布，只是为了做点什么。

sentences.en: So the next year I had estranged from my father by that point.
sentences.zh: 所以第二年，那时我已经和父亲疏远了。

sentences.en: And I remember just thinking, do I want to have lost this thing forever because of what happened to me in the past?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时就在想，难道我要因为过去发生在我身上的事，而永远失去这个节日吗？

sentences.en: Well, no, I don't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，我不想。

sentences.en: I want to reclaim it, hence the title of the book, Reclaiming Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我想找回它，这就是书名《找回圣诞节》的由来。

sentences.en: And I did an active experiment over about six weeks and I did all sorts of all sorts of different well-being techniques and healing techniques, focusing on different aspects.
sentences.zh: 我进行了大约六周的积极实验，我尝试了各种各样的健康技巧和疗愈方法，专注于不同的方面。

sentences.en: So, for example, around the mind, I was thinking about affirmations.
sentences.zh: 例如，关于心理方面，我考虑过肯定语。

sentences.en: Now, positive affirmations can be done really badly.
sentences.zh: 现在，积极的肯定语如果用得不好，效果会很差。

sentences.en: And I, with my scientific background, I have quite a, I care a lot about evidence and how these things are used.
sentences.zh: 而我，凭借我的科学背景，我非常在意证据以及这些东西是如何被使用的。

sentences.en: So for me, for example, just saying, I am not fearful.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，例如，仅仅说“我不害怕”。

sentences.en: I can do it.
sentences.zh: “我能做到”。

sentences.en: I'm brave enough to do anything I want was just not true because fear has been such a core aspect of my life.
sentences.zh: “我有足够的勇气去做任何我想做的事”，这根本不是事实，因为恐惧一直是我生活中核心的一部分。

sentences.en: So it was more about saying, I am becoming less fearful.
sentences.zh: 所以更重要的是说，“我正在变得不那么害怕”。

sentences.en: I am learning to, you know, words like that.
sentences.zh: “我正在学习……”，你知道，诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: So the mind, the emotions, the body and the spirit, just finding different ways to, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以心理、情绪、身体和精神，只是找到不同的方法来，是的。

sentences.en: I was just going to interject because you've really nicely given us an in to OCD as well.
sentences.zh: 我正想插一句，因为你刚才很好地为我们引出了强迫症（OCD）的话题。

sentences.en: So with OCD, you might have like a magic thought or phrase or kind of action that calms whatever it is that, you know, that makes it okay.
sentences.zh: 对于强迫症，你可能会有一些神奇的想法、短语或某种动作，能让你平静下来，或者让你觉得一切都好。

sentences.en: And that, that almost, that, that, that, that affirmation almost could have been that, like, I'm safe, I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 而那个，那个几乎，那个肯定语几乎可能就是那样，比如，“我是安全的，我很好”。

sentences.en: Like, but actually that loses its potency over time, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 但是，实际上这种方法随着时间的推移会失去效力，不是吗？

sentences.en: And then you kind of need to ramp it up.
sentences.zh: 然后你需要加强它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think, as I say, for me, with me with affirmations, it's a bit like have a statement that is stretching you, but not stretching you so that you break or a bit like a muscle.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正如我所说，对我而言，肯定语就像是一个能让你伸展的陈述，但不能伸展过度导致你崩溃，就像肌肉一样。

sentences.en: You might pull your muscle if you try to stretch too far.
sentences.zh: 如果你拉伸得太远，可能会拉伤肌肉。

sentences.en: And so the way I try and do it with myself and with clients is just, you know, you're stretching yourself more and more over time and that gets you to a stronger position.
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试对自己和客户使用的方法是，你知道，随着时间的推移，你不断地伸展自己，这会让你处于一个更强大的位置。

sentences.en: So, and yeah, I just, I did, to give you the, the inside scoop, I did reclaim my Christmas.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，为了给你透露内幕，我确实找回了我的圣诞节。

sentences.en: I now do love it again, but it did require being quite intentional and things like when bad memories came back to me, what did I do with that?
sentences.zh: 我现在又爱上它了，但这确实需要非常刻意，比如当糟糕的记忆浮现时，我该怎么处理？

sentences.en: How did I deal with that?
sentences.zh: 我该如何应对？

sentences.en: So it wasn't all just fun and games.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不全是好玩和游戏。

sentences.en: There was an element of how do I hold space?
sentences.zh: 其中有一个要素是：我该如何留出空间？

sentences.en: I remember one day in my journal and journaling has become very important to me.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一天在我的日记里——写日记对我来说变得非常重要。

sentences.en: I just did a huge, great scribble on the page in the run up to Christmas.
sentences.zh: 在圣诞节前夕，我在页面上乱涂乱画了一大通。

sentences.en: It was, it wasn't even words.
sentences.zh: 那甚至算不上是文字。

sentences.en: It was just a massive scribble.
sentences.zh: 那只是一大片乱涂乱画。

sentences.en: And I'm, I'm really quite, I like my journal and I treat it quite well and I felt really bad, but I just had to get it out.
sentences.zh: 我，我其实很喜欢我的日记，我对待它很认真，当时我感觉很糟糕，但我必须把它发泄出来。

sentences.en: And there were different ways, obviously of, you know, expressing our emotions safely, but also being honest with ourselves as well.
sentences.zh: 显然有不同的方法来安全地表达我们的情绪，同时也要对自己诚实。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Where can people get the book if they would like to?
sentences.zh: 如果人们想要这本书，可以在哪里买到？

sentences.en: I'll obviously pop a link in the show notes, but if they want to head straight there, where can they get hold of a copy?
sentences.zh: 我显然会在节目说明里放一个链接，但如果他们想直接去买，在哪里可以买到副本？

sentences.en: So it's on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 它在亚马逊上。

sentences.en: You can get paperback or Kindle, or I even recorded an audio book version upstairs in a little cupboard.
sentences.zh: 你可以买平装本或Kindle版，或者我甚至在楼上的小储藏室里录制了有声书版本。

sentences.en: So you've got all the options if you want it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想要的话，所有的选择都有。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think just before we started, you were saying that you've got a little sibling for your book coming along as well.
sentences.zh: 我想在我们开始之前，你说过你还有一本关于你书的“小兄弟”作品即将问世。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about that one?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们聊聊那本吗？

sentences.en: Yes, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: So my second book is in its early stages.
sentences.zh: 我的第二本书还处于早期阶段。

sentences.en: It hasn't got a title yet, but effectively it's about sing after the storm.
sentences.zh: 它还没有标题，但实际上它是关于“风暴过后的歌唱”。

sentences.en: And the idea is, how do you find your voice?
sentences.zh: 核心理念是：你如何找到自己的声音？

sentences.en: How do you find your song and then sing it with gusto after you've been through a storm?
sentences.zh: 在你经历了一场风暴之后，你如何找到你的歌，然后充满激情地唱出来？

sentences.en: And I think particularly for a lot of us, it's not just one storm.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我们许多人来说，这不仅仅是一场风暴。

sentences.en: It's kind of multiple storms that one goes through and it can leave one a bit disorientated, a bit small, you know, all of those things.
sentences.zh: 这更像是经历了一连串的风暴，这会让人感到有点迷失方向，有点渺小，你知道，所有这些感觉。

sentences.en: So my work and that book is going to be all about how do we make that journey, not just to get out of the storm in one piece, but then to grow positively afterwards.
sentences.zh: 所以我的工作和那本书将完全关于我们如何完成那段旅程，不仅是完整地走出风暴，而且之后还能积极地成长。

sentences.en: So, yes, I'm working on that now.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我现在正在写那本书。

sentences.en: And if you're interested, you can head over to my website to have a little poke around.
sentences.zh: 如果你感兴趣，可以去我的网站上逛逛。

sentences.en: And that's damselnotindistress.co.uk.
sentences.zh: And that's damselnotindistress.co.uk.

sentences.en: Okay, lovely.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Can we also follow you on socials somewhere as well, Alexandra?
sentences.zh: Alexandra，我们可以在社交媒体上关注你吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am on, you can find me on Facebook and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 可以，你可以在Facebook和Instagram上找到我。

sentences.en: I can give you the details and we can pop them underneath.
sentences.zh: 我可以给你详细信息，我们可以把它们放在下面。

sentences.en: Variations on damselnotindistress, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是damselnotindistress的各种变体。

sentences.en: Okay, perfect.
sentences.zh: 好的，完美。

sentences.en: You're not on LinkedIn, though.
sentences.zh: 不过你不在LinkedIn上。

sentences.en: I love LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢LinkedIn。

sentences.en: Yes, I actually am.
sentences.zh: 是的，其实我在。

sentences.en: I don't think about it so much these days because I'm not so much in the corporate space, but I'm still there.
sentences.zh: 我最近不太常想起它，因为我不太在企业领域活动，但我还在那里。

sentences.en: Okay, so you're Alexandra Walker on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你在LinkedIn上叫Alexandra Walker。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: I'll make sure that I connect and we'll share all of your details.
sentences.zh: 我会确保与你建立联系，并分享你的所有详细信息。

sentences.en: If you ping those over to me, we can make sure that they're all in the show notes and magically on screen as well for people that are watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果你把这些发给我，我们可以确保它们都出现在节目说明中，对于在YouTube上观看的人来说，也会神奇地出现在屏幕上。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time and helping illuminate our audience about your experiences, but also kind of the more wider concepts involved in emotional abuse and complex trauma.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间，帮助我们的听众了解你的经历，以及涉及情感虐待和复杂创伤的更广泛概念。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure to be here.
sentences.zh: 能来这里是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I want to be on your team.
sentences.zh: 我想加入你的团队。

sentences.en: I want to help you keep striving for whatever professional qualification route it is that you want to achieve.
sentences.zh: 我想帮助你继续为你想实现的任何专业资格途径而努力。

sentences.en: Please, with that in mind, do come and connect and follow with me over on my social channels.
sentences.zh: 请记住这一点，一定要来我的社交频道与我联系并关注我。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, everywhere that you could hope to imagine.
sentences.zh: 我是Marianne Trent博士，在你能想象到的任何地方都能找到我。

sentences.en: And if you're watching this on YouTube, please do like, subscribe, share your favourite episodes with your friends.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在YouTube上观看此视频，请点赞、订阅，并与你的朋友分享你最喜欢的剧集。

sentences.en: That would be so appreciated.
sentences.zh: 那将不胜感激。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this as an MP3, please do take a moment to rate and review on Apple Podcasts and to give me a rating.
